news.h: Exotic Bazaar to build $2.35M food production facility in Ballarat
news.p: Food brand Exotic Bazaar will invest $2.35 million in its own blending, packaging and fulfilment facility in Ballarat, Victoria, creating about 18 jobs.

news.h: Hydrogen pilot targets lower power use in steelmaking
news.p: An Australian pilot project is testing hydrogen as a way to cut the electricity needed to manufacture steel.

news.h: ARENA funds $6.77M Melbourne battery manufacturing project
news.p: The Australian Renewable Energy Agency has committed $6.77 million to support a battery manufacturing project based in Melbourne.

news.h: Queensland grant helps MooGoo bring skincare production to Gold Coast
news.p: A $1.3M Transforming Queensland Manufacturing grant will fund new equipment so MooGoo can make more products at its Gold Coast plant instead of outsourcing interstate, adding about 25 jobs.

news.h: Ballarat flour mill among ASSDA stainless fabrication award winners
news.p: Four stainless steel projects won 2026 ASSDA fabricator awards, including A&G Engineering's work on Mauri's new Ballarat flour mill handling over 500 tonnes of wheat a day, plus data centre cooling pipework.

news.h: Hunter Manufacturing Awards name 2026 regional winners
news.p: Apollo Engineering and Elecbrakes shared Manufacturer of the Year, Pitcrew AI took innovation and export awards for mining inspection tech, and Downer with Sydney Trains won a partnership award for Tangara fleet life extension.

news.h: NSW calls for developer of Bradfield City manufacturing precinct
news.p: The NSW Government is seeking a private developer for an advanced-manufacturing enterprise precinct at Bradfield City in Western Sydney, starting with about 6.7 hectares and possibly seven more later.

news.h: Australian manufacturing PMI stays in contraction at 49.6
news.p: S&P Global's October index was unchanged at 49.6, with new orders falling at the fastest pace in almost two years and supplier delays and input costs rising.

news.h: Aluminium Council wants bauxite and alumina on critical minerals list
news.p: The industry body's new report argues bauxite, alumina and aluminium should be listed as critical minerals, warning refinery closures and rising Indonesian capacity threaten a $7.9 billion alumina refining sector.

news.h: WA opens $153M low-interest energy loan scheme for manufacturers
news.p: Western Australia's Made in WA Energy Affordability Investment Program offers loans of $300,000 to $15 million for manufacturers' efficiency, renewables, storage and electrification projects; applications close 23 February 2027.

news.h: Generation Steel signs BHP renewable power deal for Collie mill
news.p: Generation Steel agreed a binding power purchase deal with BHP to supply wind and solar electricity for its proposed lower-carbon steel mill at Collie, WA. Capacity and timing details are still to come.

news.h: Visy spends $30M upgrading Smithfield corrugated box plant
news.p: Visy is installing new cardboard equipment at its Smithfield factory in Western Sydney, led by a 2.8-metre corrugator expected to lift board output by a third at a site employing over 400 staff.

news.h: ARENA funds thermal-storage steam for Rio Tinto Yarwun refinery
news.p: ARENA will provide up to $41.6 million in staged funding for an electric thermal energy storage system at the Yarwun alumina refinery near Gladstone, generating process steam from stored renewable heat.

news.h: NSW picks Teralba ex-mine site for state train factory
news.p: The NSW Government named Glencore's former Teralba mine near Lake Macquarie as the preferred site for a state-owned train manufacturing plant, part of a $12B fleet program, with about 550 ongoing jobs expected.

news.h: Victoria funds $15M of regional industrial infrastructure
news.p: The state is backing ten regional projects, including a water pipeline upgrade at Parwan near Bacchus Marsh that could open up to 190 hectares of industrial land for manufacturing and food processing.

news.h: Canberra consults on mandatory low-carbon fuel purchases
news.p: The federal government is seeking views on requiring fuel suppliers to buy or supply set volumes of low-carbon liquid fuels such as biofuels, aiming to lift local demand and fuel resilience.

news.h: Ampol Lytton margins surge but extended maintenance trims Q4 output
news.p: Ampol's Lytton refiner margin more than doubled year on year in the September quarter, but extended cracking-unit maintenance will cut about 150 million litres of higher-value fuel output, with restart expected mid-November.

news.h: Coca-Cola Europacific adds $39.7M can line at Kewdale, WA
news.p: CCEP installed a new can production line at its Kewdale plant, lifting capacity by more than 40 per cent to about 1,500 cans per minute.

news.h: SunRice to build rice cake plant in Leeton with federal funding
news.p: Canberra is putting $14.5 million, matched by SunRice, into a new rice processing facility at Leeton in the Riverina, supporting more than 200 jobs.

news.h: $21.6M food manufacturing expansions in Melbourne's north
news.p: The Victorian Government is backing food manufacturers in Melbourne's north with combined investments of $21.6 million to lift production and exports and add almost 50 jobs.

news.h: Project Ceres passes 79% construction
news.p: Perdaman's 2.3 Mt/yr urea plant on the Burrup is 85% complete overall, with the Saipem–Clough joint venture as EPC contractor. Perdaman is now recruiting its operations engineers.

news.h: Viva's Geelong renewable diesel gains ISCC+ certification
news.p: Co-processing of renewable feedstocks at the Geelong refinery is in its initial phase, with an expansion study under way.

news.h: NSW endorses five fuel-security projects
news.p: Southern Oil's Wagga re-refinery, Bomen biomethane, Quantem's Botany expansion and Vopak's SAF-capable aviation fuel tanks are among the projects backed by the state.

news.h: Air Liquide plans new air separation unit at Yennora, NSW
news.p: Air Liquide will add an air separation unit at its Fairfield site in Yennora to make nitrogen and oxygen for industrial and medical users, with start-up targeted for 2028.

news.h: Western Sydney Aerotropolis private investment reaches $34.6B
news.p: The Bradfield Development Authority reports $34.6 billion of private investment, with new advanced manufacturing and technology facilities expanding the region's industrial base.

news.h: Government support keeps Bell Bay aluminium smelter running to 2031
news.p: Federal and Tasmanian governments are putting $200 million over five years, alongside a new power deal, into keeping the Bell Bay smelter operating, protecting about 550 direct jobs.

news.h: Queensland fast-tracks three steel and metals projects worth $1.9B
news.p: Queensland declared the Alter and Swanbank steel mills and Sims Metal's Pinkenba redevelopment Prescribed Projects, backing over $1.9 billion of private investment and an estimated 2,000 construction jobs.

news.h: Baiada opens large poultry processing plant in Tamworth
news.p: Baiada's new Tamworth facility combines automated processing, packaging and logistics, handling about 1.5 million birds weekly, with approval to double that if a second line is added.

news.h: Grants back PPG Clayton expansion and five other south-east plants
news.p: Victoria is sharing over $5 million in grants among six Melbourne south-east manufacturers, including PPG's Clayton site, supporting almost $70 million of investment and 312 jobs.

news.h: Jet Zero's Townsville SAF refinery gets final development approval
news.p: Project Ulysses in Townsville cleared its final development approval and closed a $30 million raise backed by Qantas and Airbus, with Posco International joining; about 1,000 construction jobs are expected.
